cases.name: Ellen Anne Higgins Elfstrom
cases.about: She worked for the South Brunswick School District as a secretary and later as a secretary for a doctor in New Brunswick. She enjoyed music, sewing and reading, according to her obituary. She was divorced and had been alone for over 20 years, according to neighbors. She had a daughter who lived out of state and she spoke of a son and brothers, but neighbors said they never saw them at her house.
cases.narrative: On 5/01/2009, her body was found on her bed. She died of blunt-force trauma caused by blows to her head that crushed her skull and splattered blood on her bedroom walls.
